name: hud_ui_set_invalidate_mode
description: HudUi::SetInvalidateMode selects the HUD invalidation mask used by element invalidation.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bc760 writes g_HudUi_InvalidateMask to 0x04 when mode is zero and 0x0c when mode is nonzero.
The native smoke calls HudUi::SetInvalidateMode(0) and verifies g_HudUi_InvalidateMask becomes 0x04.
The native smoke calls HudUi::SetInvalidateMode(1) and verifies g_HudUi_InvalidateMask becomes 0x0c.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4bc760 reports zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking with VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs.
